claim: ECDSA 256-bit is one of the supported key algorithms for Network Load Balancer server certificates.
question: Does a Network Load Balancer TLS listener accept ECDSA certificates?

qualifiers.scope: per Network Load Balancer TLS listener certificate

note: The supported list also has RSA 1024, 2048, 3072-bit and ECDSA 384 and 521-bit (document history 2024-01-19). The ELB FAQ still says NLB supports only RSA 2K and no ECDSA; the user guide is current.
